title: Focal Dyad Retention in Conditional Randomization Tests for Unequal Two-Sided Markets
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=incremental below floor=field; paper_score_ceiling 5.9 < 7.4, and the delivered package remains narrow and impractical despite being mathematically sound.
gap_reasons: The note proves a nontrivial all-optimizer two-macroscopic-block theorem and an exact affine-catalog representation, but that catalog applies only beyond a factorially enormous threshold and is complete only as an exhaustive finite definition, not as an operational phase enumeration.

The exact optimizer and exact comparator gap are established only for the specialized R=4, (delta_B,delta_S)=(1,3) slice; for general R, the two-fiber construction supplies an achievability bound rather than the exact frontier.

The randomization inversion is valid but largely converts the selected orbit through standard sharp-null conditioning, so it does not by itself elevate the narrow and presently impractical combinatorial result to a field-level contribution.
proof_attempt_summary: The run discharged the full structural theorem graph and sharpened the general comparator construction to logarithmic block count, while both mathematical and decision panels reported no correctness findings. The field-tier claim collapsed because the stabilization threshold remains factorially enormous, the catalog is finite-in-principle rather than operational, and exact optimality is confined to a narrow R=4 slice. A future re-raise needs a genuinely operational stabilization/active-phase theorem or a broader inferential consequence, not another constant improvement.
tldr: For the same prescribed unequal margins and the same predeclared minimum common-status orbit resolution, the unique exact-divisibility homogeneous positive-cover specialization of Liu--Shaikh--Toulis retains only \(6n+3\) focal dyads. An explicit two-fiber unequal cover uses \(q_R=\Theta(\log R)\) unit blocks, has support at least \(R\), and retains \(6n^2-O(n\log R)\) dyads; at \(R=4\) and \(n\ge81\) it is the unique anisotropic optimizer and the exact gap is \(2(3n-1)(n-2)\). The load-bearing structural theorem gives, above an explicit fixed-imbalance threshold, exactly two coordinatewise macroscopic blocks, bounded residual mass, a finite affine frontier, and the complete equality-template list. Conditional constant-incidence randomization then yields exact null-adjusted one-sided inversion for a focal constant effect, without a claim of power or global-effect optimality.
gap: Liu--Shaikh--Toulis validate an equal nonoverlapping common-status block rule and explain its support/focal-size tradeoff, but do not characterize the best positive paired cover at prescribed unequal margins or quantify the retained-area cost of homogeneity. General biclique validity, generic IQP, and one-parameter Presburger regularity likewise do not provide the permutation-invariant two-macroscopic-block theorem, the complete finite affine equality catalog, or the same-margin homogeneous comparison.
fill: The project will prove the forced homogeneous comparator and a general-R quadratic retention lower bound, with an exact optimizer gap only for \(R=4\). It will establish the supporting all-optimizer stabilization and affine equality catalog by a benchmark concentration bound, signed witness-equation replacement, loss comparison, and residual coefficient enumeration, then separately prove constant-incidence exact inversion. It does not claim inferential dominance, equal actual support sizes, all unequal margins, all Liu--Shaikh--Toulis variants, unrestricted bicliques, or global optimality.
